notes.title: The Waiting is (really) Over
notes.notes:
Steam contacted me back saying the problem has been fixed and the game is now available to play (properly). I have confirmed it with my test account.

To clarify: this is a free to play game through and through. None of the four chapters will require payment.

Hope you have a good time with it. Would love to hear back.
